_note: SWIPES Canada editor summaries, written by our team in our own words. A notice gets an indexable story page only when it has one here (or is hand-curated in scripts/curated_notices.json). Notices with too little public detail (media advisories, untitled updates) stay noindex on purpose.

summaries.3ef75541256c5b052697: Prime Minister Carney issued a statement marking 30 years since the Royal Commission on Aboriginal Peoples delivered its final report. The original statement is on the Prime Minister's website.
summaries.48b33d5b9fc8b06e616b: Le Directeur des poursuites criminelles et pénales (DPCP) a déposé des accusations contre deux policiers du Service de police de la Ville de Montréal, après avoir examiné un rapport d'enquête lié au poste de quartier 39.
summaries.35fad591f04170ad8f03: Québec accorde 26 790 $ au Grand Marché de Noël de Québec, présenté jusqu'au 24 décembre, dans le cadre de son appui aux festivals et événements de l'hiver et du printemps 2026-2027.
summaries.6565bbc7797ee31a5e52: Saskatchewan has named the new hospital planned for Rosthern: it will be called Sask Valley Hospital, a name chosen to reflect the wider area it will serve.
summaries.5b7b13ddf663e975f64e: Saskatchewan is looking at bioenergy and secondary wood processing as a way to support its forestry sector and help meet future energy needs, including possible partnerships on new projects.
summaries.852eb83ea8c2a52efd7a: Saskatchewan is funding a new PET/CT scanner for Royal University Hospital in Saskatoon, an imaging machine used mainly to find and track cancer and other conditions.
summaries.772fa6f353e19d14be90: Manitoba is setting up its first advisory table for commercial fishers, giving the industry a regular way to advise the province on fisheries decisions.
summaries.9e1665d216fb7c601dc7: Saskatchewan is putting $6.9 million toward 49 police positions in Regina, aimed at more frontline officers and faster response times.
summaries.429a0ff7d5c54ea29fc7: Ontario reports that two people were fined for hunting deer unlawfully on St. Joseph Island. The original notice has the charges and fine amounts.
summaries.c5491f86ccae1e226882: Ontario's coroner's office has announced an inquest into the death of Clarence Strong. The original notice lists the date, location and how to follow the inquest.
summaries.eec9c6ac8435ee499eb5: X-ray services are back at the Dr. A. A. Wilkinson Memorial Health Centre in Old Perlican, Newfoundland and Labrador, with a new digital machine installed as the centre marks 25 years.
summaries.2567a7710999b36c5ebe: Newfoundland and Labrador's environment minister has published decisions under the province's environmental assessment process, including a resubmitted quarry project near Happy Valley-Goose Bay. The bulletin lists each project and its status.
summaries.f4fa2f53577f7c317ffe: On National Child Day, Prince Edward Island launched Don't Wait, Make the Call, a campaign encouraging Islanders to report concerns about a child's safety.
summaries.6499b2fc50345445cf06: Ontario is funding more mental health supports for public safety personnel such as police, firefighters and paramedics. The original notice lists the programs.
summaries.ea2df4aecad17948720f: Alberta has updated its parent toolkit, which gathers learning-at-home resources for students from kindergarten to grade 9 in one place.
summaries.01f83d5c75e87cfbece8: After a federal, provincial and territorial meeting of housing ministers, Yukon said it welcomes continued joint work on housing priorities.
summaries.1c18eeb96cdfdde9f118: Alberta is investing $1.7 million in 13 projects that help value-added wood manufacturers create new products and broaden the province's forest industry.
summaries.30113316d07b43cf4e77: A fibre expansion by EH!tel is complete in Bruce and Grey counties, Ontario, bringing high-speed internet within reach of thousands of rural residents.
